audit_kind: Independent source-and-existing-evidence progress audit; no new native execution

conclusion.reason: No complete behavioral/ownership inventory or weighted closure denominator exists. Source lines, hook counts, tests and commits cannot supply it. The earlier roughly 10 percent estimate was not calibrated and cannot measure ten-hour progress.
conclusion.domain_count_interpretation: Zero of eleven broad planning domains can currently be certified closed; domains are unequal and this is not zero percent implementation. Substantial verified leaf work exists.
conclusion.default_build: Native implementation retained; Rust-enabled candidate selected with RustTextDecoder=true for supported Release Win32/x64 configurations.

method.tree_source: git archive of both exact commits, read as tar archives; no working-tree or artifact/generated-source counts in source inventory.
method.physical_lines: len(blob.splitlines()); includes blank/comment/test/retained preprocessor-branch lines. Extensions listed below.
method.changed: Raw byte comparison of same baseline path; no baseline source files deleted. Byte equality includes line endings.
method.rust_hooks: Lexical presence of XY_VSFILTER_RUST\w* or xy_vsfilter_\w* or xy_rust_\w*. Indicates integration footprint only; does not prove reachability, replacement size, ownership closure or runtime coverage.
method.inventory_scope: All 3737 baseline tracked files examined for source extensions. First-party application scale separated from BaseClasses, SDK/public headers, vendored libraries and tests. Project compile entry counts are configuration-unresolved and may overlap; not a runtime dependency closure.
method.evidence_review: Read committed evidence summaries, scopes and checks at their exact candidate SHAs; archived reports are not asserted to validate later HEAD. This independent audit did not revalidate all raw capture hashes or query current CI.
method.production_review: Source inspection of native build switch, document and renderer containers, SSF adapters, Plane/ByteStorage/PathBuffer adapters, experimental VobSub gate, and host project source lists.
method.reproduction: For inventory use git ls-tree -r --name-only REV and git show REV:PATH (or git archive REV); select extensions, group paths as listed, count splitlines and compare raw blobs. For ten-hour activity use git diff --numstat START END and git rev-list --count START..END. All input commits and selection rules are included.

safety_progress_classes.credit: Application logic implemented under forbid(unsafe_code), with bounded Rust collections/slices. FFI still relies on native input lifetime/validity contracts.
safety_progress_classes.not_credit: Does not close surrounding native document/renderer/host lifecycles.

safety_progress_classes.class: Opaque owned collections with bounded access
safety_progress_classes.credit: Lookahead and literal vectors plus immutable input snapshots move meaningful ownership and indexing into Rust.
safety_progress_classes.not_credit: CStringW fallback/alias anchors and final native definition/document ownership remain; input modes and decline paths differ.

safety_progress_classes.class: Rust-owned allocation with native raw access
safety_progress_classes.credit: Allocation, size checks and release path moved into bounded owner abstractions.
safety_progress_classes.not_credit: Native writers still receive raw pointer loans. This is not equivalent to moving all accesses into safe Rust or memory-safety closure.

safety_progress_classes.credit: Experimental and fallback status is explicitly represented.
safety_progress_classes.not_credit: XY_VSFILTER_RUST_VOBSUB_STORAGE_EXPERIMENT does not receive production migration credit; native fallback execution remains part of scope.

scope.integrated: SSF queue ownership, safe comment/peek state transitions, output code-unit encoding and Arabic replacement.
scope.validation: All four portable jobs, Miri, both full Windows renderer jobs and exact-commit local sanitizer campaign passed. Each renderer matched 798 cases / 8426 frames plus 32 mutation cases / 224 frames and scoped COM controls.
scope.limits: CSRI does not exercise SSF rendering. Actual native SSF parser/dump checks were added later and have their own evidence. Later byte/UTF-16 input snapshots, BOM/UTF-16 assembly and Windows evidence-test newline repair are not included. Earlier failures remain failed.

limits: Finite fixtures and mutation campaigns do not establish universal compatibility or memory safety.
CSRI BGRX rendering and format queries; real Aegisub/player and other host integration remains outstanding.
Comparisons pair reference and candidate on the same architecture and environment, not across architectures.
Most native parsing, font handling, rasterization, compositing and third-party code remains C++.
Drawing preprocessing, numeric conversion, scaling and final path storage remain native.
Native sanitizers cover extracted C++ tests, not the full renderer or Rust static library.
Native out-of-memory recovery, Windows 7 and older CPUs remain unverified.
WebVTT end-of-list insertion has candidate-only validation and is excluded from reference-parity counts.

reviewed_evidence.scope: Actual separately linked SSF parser and six-encoding node dumps. Exact native start/stop/seek traces and blank-frame observations; zero visible SSF rendering parity frames. All captures, fixture inputs, binaries, library hashes and harness sources checked against pinned provenance. Leaf tests, Miri and whole-renderer validation are separate.

scope.integrated: Gaussian output planes, common RLE storage, vector clip masks, HDMV segment storage, DVB packet growth and banner/scroll fades, with repaired initialization-mask and metadata fixtures.
scope.disabled_experiment: Persistent VobSub image ownership is tested only under XY_VSFILTER_RUST_VOBSUB_STORAGE_EXPERIMENT; production Rust builds retain native storage pending settings-copy and alias-lifetime coverage.
scope.strict_fp: Unix fade oracle uses Clang strict FP; Windows uses MSVC /fp:strict. GCC ambient-flag mismatches remain unresolved in clip-fade-fp-scope.json. Actual DLLs use production flags.
scope.renderer: Both architectures match 798 cases / 8426 frames and 32 mutation cases / 224 frames; scroll visibility controls now pass at corrected early sample times. Older failed jobs remain failed.
scope.not_included: Later scaler scratch, fractional blur scratch, shifted bitmaps, composite masks and COM probes require their own job results.
scope.local: No separate full local run at this exact repair commit. Earlier and later complete local sanitizer reports are archived separately and are not substituted for this commit.

ten_hour_activity.interpretation: Substantial implementation and compatibility scaffolding activity; increasingly small leaf and allocation increments rather than completed end-to-end components. Counts cannot infer useful-work hours, CI waiting time, remaining hours or percent completion.

recommended_measurement.unit: A named public operation or owned lifetime, connected to complete production call paths and a specific closure contract; not one module file or test.
per_unit_fields: all call sites and host surfaces
status_ladder: all production paths enabled or bounded adapters specified

next_concrete_package.name: CSimpleTextSubtitle entries/styles/segments lifecycle
next_concrete_package.initial_state: Field and timeline helper implementations exist; native owning arrays/styles and surrounding lifecycle still need explicit inventory and closure.

recommended_measurement.reporting: Report changed status counts within a frozen package inventory, plus owned lifetimes/accesses retired and exact validated commit. Keep inventory additions visible. Do not sum unequal domains or infer whole-product percentage until a defensible weighting/denominator is established.

limitations: No complete behavioral inventory exists, especially intentional malformed-input interactions.
No lexical source measure identifies native fallback reachability or equivalent replacement complexity.
No whole-repo preprocessor/call-graph extraction was attempted; unchanged files can call migrated functions through shared code, and changed files can remain mostly native.

Vendored source includes unused headers, tests, alternate platforms and SDK/interface declarations; its full line total must not be treated as required Rust rewrite scope. A runtime dependency inventory is required.
Finite matching differential fixtures support observed behavior and cannot prove all inputs.
This audit assesses migration progress rather than original-code safety findings or an overall memory-safety certification.
